name: Silent Floor Push-Up
formCues: Set hands under shoulders, spread fingers, and screw palms lightly into the mat.
Keep body in a straight line from ears to heels; brace ribs down and glutes tight.
Lower with elbows at 30-45 degrees until chest hovers above mat, then press evenly through palms.
Exhale on press, keep neck neutral, and avoid dropping hips at the bottom.
safetyWarning: Stop immediately if you feel sharp shoulder, elbow, or wrist pain. Keep the movement silent and controlled; no bouncing or collapsing at the bottom.

name: Elevated Desk Incline Push-Up
formCues: Place hands shoulder-width on a stable desk or bed frame edge; step feet back to a firm plank.
Keep elbows tracking slightly back, not flared wide, while maintaining a neutral spine.
Lower chest toward the edge slowly, pause briefly, then press back without locking elbows hard.
Move quietly through full control; adjust foot distance to keep RPE at or below cap.
safetyWarning: Use only a stable, non-rolling surface. Stop if the surface shifts, wrists hurt, or shoulder pain appears.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press (2kg Pair)
formCues: Lie on mat with knees bent, feet flat, and dumbbells held above chest with wrists stacked.
Lower elbows until upper arms gently touch the floor; keep forearms vertical.
Press dumbbells up smoothly without clanging them together at the top.
Maintain ribcage down and glutes lightly engaged to protect lower back.
safetyWarning: Do not drop dumbbells. Stop if you feel shoulder pinching or elbow pain. Keep tempo slow and silent on the floor contact.

name: Backpack Tempo Squat
formCues: Hold loaded backpack close to chest or wear it snug; feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Brace core and inhale as you sit hips back and down with controlled tempo.
Keep heels planted and knees tracking over mid-foot; descend only to a pain-free depth.
Exhale and drive through whole foot to stand, avoiding knee lockout slam.
safetyWarning: Use a securely packed backpack; loose books can shift. Stop for knee, hip, or lower-back pain. No jumping or bouncing.

name: Silent Glute Bridge
formCues: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat hip-width; arms rest palms-down for stability.
Exhale and drive through heels to lift hips until shoulders-hips-knees align.
Squeeze glutes at top for one second without overextending lower back.
Lower hips slowly with control, keeping ribs down and neck relaxed on mat.
safetyWarning: Stop if you feel lower-back pinch or hamstring cramp. Keep neck neutral on the mat; this is not a neck bridge variation.

name: Dead Bug Core Control
formCues: Lie on back with arms above shoulders and knees bent at 90 degrees over hips.
Press lower back gently toward mat and brace core before moving limbs.
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping ribs heavy and back contact stable.
Return with control and alternate sides, breathing steadily without rushing.
safetyWarning: Stop if lower back lifts off the mat or you feel neck strain. Move only within a range you can control silently.
